item.title: Visualising Strava bike rides
item.description: Like most of us I meticulously record every bike ride I do with a popular app among athletes called Strava. Strava is often described as the Facebook for athletes. It works by simply hitting the start button when going out for a run or bike ride and it will record a series of GPS coordinates until you hit stop again. Afterwards the athlete gets a report that shows a map with the route followed alongside with some graphs on speed, hearth rate and other data.
